package sample

import "time"

const (
	OpA uint16 = 0x4001
	OpB uint16 = 0x43b0 // a comment
	Bit        = 1 << 24
	Mask       = Bit | Low | (1 << 2)
	Low        = 0x20
	Clear      = Mask &^ Low
	Sum        = 2*3 + 4 - 1
	Name       = "text"
	Wait       = 5 * time.Second
	Other      = pkg.Value | Low
	Big        = 1 << 62 << 1
)

const (
	First = iota
	Second
)

const Lone = 161

var notConst = 7
